verses.geez: ሥርዓተ፡ ገበርኩ፡ ለአዕይንትየ፡ ወኢነጸርክዋ፡ ለድንግል።
verses.translation: I made a covenant with mine eyes, and I will not think upon a virgin.

translations.lxx: I made a covenant with mine eyes, and I will not think upon a virgin.
translations.kjv: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
translations.ron: Făcusem legământ cu ochii mei şi asupra unei fecioare nu-i ridicam.
translations.grk: Διαθήκην ἐθέμην τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς μου, καὶ οὐ συνήσω ἐπὶ παρθένον.

verses.geez: ወዓዲ፡ ክፍለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኢበላዕኩ፡ ወርስቶሂ፡ ለኃያል፡ እምአርያም።
verses.translation: Now what portion has God given from above? and is there an inheritance given of the Mighty One from the highest?

translations.lxx: Now what portion has God given from above? and is there an inheritance given of the Mighty One from the highest?
translations.kjv: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
translations.ron: Şi care este partea pe care Dumnezeu o trimite din ceruri şi ce câştig hărăzeşte, din înălţime, Cel Atotputernic?
translations.grk: Καὶ τί ἐμέρισεν ὁ Θεὸς ἄνωθεν, καὶ κληρονομία ἱκανοῦ ἐξ ὑψίστων;

verses.geez: አሌ፡ ሎ፡ ለሞተ፡ ዓመፂ፡ ወተናክሮቶሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይገብርዋ፡ ለኃጢአት።
verses.translation: Alas! destruction to the unrighteous, and rejection to them that do iniquity.

translations.lxx: Alas! destruction to the unrighteous, and rejection to them that do iniquity.
translations.kjv: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
translations.ron: Nefericirea nu este ea oare pentru cel nedrept şi nenorocirea pentru făptuitorii fărădelegii?
translations.grk: Οὐαί, ἀπώλεια τῷ ἀδίκῳ, καὶ ἀπαλλοτρίωσις τοῖς ποιοῦσιν ἀνομίαν.

verses.geez: አኮኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ይርእያ፡ ለፍኖትየ፡ ወኈለቈ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሥግረትየ።
verses.translation: Will he not see my way, and number all my steps?

translations.lxx: Will he not see my way, and number all my steps?
translations.kjv: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
translations.ron: Nu vede, oare, Dumnezeu căile mele şi nu numără El toţi paşii mei?
translations.grk: Οὐχὶ αὐτὸς ὄψεται ὁδόν μου, καὶ πάντα τὰ διαβήματά μου ἐξαριθμήσεται;

verses.geez: ሶበዑ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ምስለ፡ መስተሣልቃን፡ ወሶበሁ፡ ተግኅሠት፡ እግርየ፡ እምፍኖቱ።
verses.translation: But if I had gone with scorners, and if too my foot has hasted to deceit:

translations.lxx: But if I had gone with scorners, and if too my foot has hasted to deceit:
translations.kjv: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
translations.ron: Umblat-am oare întru minciună şi picioarele mele au zorit spre înşelăciune?
translations.grk: Εἰ δὲ ἤμην πεπορευμένος μετὰ γελοιαστῶν, εἰ δὲ καὶ ἐσπούδασεν ὁ πούς μου εἰς δόλον·

verses.geez: ወቆምኩ፡ በዳልወ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወየአምር፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ የዋሃትየ።
verses.translation: (for I am weighed in a just balance, and the Lord knows my innocence:)

translations.lxx: (for I am weighed in a just balance, and the Lord knows my innocence:)
translations.kjv: Let me be weighed in an even balance that God may know mine integrity.
translations.ron: Să mă cântărească în cumpăna dreptăţii şi Dumnezeu să cunoască neprihănirea mea.
translations.grk: Ἕσταμαι γὰρ ἐν ζυγῷ δικαίῳ, οἶδε δὲ ὁ Κύριος τὴν ἀκακίαν μου·

verses.geez: ተግኅሠት፡ እግርየ፡ እምፍኖቱ፡ ወለእመሂ፡ ተለወ፡ ልብየ፡ ድኅረ፡ ዓይንየ፡ ወእመሂ፡ ተመጠውኩ፡ ሕልያነ፡ በእዴየ፡ ዘዘራእኩ፡ ባዕድ፡ ይብልዎ።
verses.translation: if my foot has turned aside out of the way, or if mine heart has followed mine eye, and if too I have touched gifts with my hands;

translations.lxx: if my foot has turned aside out of the way, or if mine heart has followed mine eye, and if too I have touched gifts with my hands;
translations.kjv: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
translations.ron: Dacă paşii mei s-au abătut de la calea cea dreaptă şi inima mea a fost târâtă de ochii mei, iar de mâinile mele s-a lipit vreo murdărie,
translations.grk: Εἰ ἐξέκλινεν ὁ πούς μου ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ, εἰ δὲ καὶ τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ ἐπηκολούθησεν ἡ καρδία μου, εἰ δὲ καὶ ταῖς χερσί μου ἡψάμην δώρων,

verses.geez: ወዘእንበለ፡ ሥርው፡ ለእኩን፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወእመሂ፡ ተለወ፡ ልብየ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወእመሂ፡ ወሐይኩ፡ ኆኅተ፡ ቤታ።
verses.translation: then let me sow, and let others eat; and let me be uprooted on the earth.

translations.lxx: then let me sow, and let others eat; and let me be uprooted on the earth.
translations.kjv: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
translations.ron: Atunci altul să mănânce ceea ce eu semăn şi vlăstarii mei să fie scoşi din rădăcină!
translations.grk: σπείραιμι ἄρα καὶ ἄλλοι φάγοισαν, ἄῤῥιζος δὲ γενοίμην ἐπὶ γῆς.

verses.geez: ብእሲትየ፡ ትአድሞ፡ ለካልእ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወደቂቅየ፡ ለይኅሠሩ፡ በመቅሠፍተ፡ መዓቱ፡ ዘይእኅዝ።
verses.translation: If my heart has gone forth after another man's wife, and if I laid wait at her doors;

translations.lxx: If my heart has gone forth after another man's wife, and if I laid wait at her doors;
translations.kjv: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;
translations.ron: Dacă inima mea a fost amăgită de vreo femeie şi am stat de pândă la uşa aproapelui meu,
translations.grk: Εἰ ἐξηκολούθησεν ἡ καρδία μου γυναικὶ ἀνδρὸς ἑτέρου, εἰ καὶ ἐγκάθετος ἐγενόμην ἐπὶ θύραις αὐτῆς,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አርኵሶ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ እሳተ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይነድድ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ መለያልይ፡ ሃበ፡ ቦአ፡ ይሤሩ፡ እምሥርው።
verses.translation: then let my wife also please another, and let my children be brought low.

translations.lxx: then let my wife also please another, and let my children be brought low.
translations.kjv: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
translations.ron: Atunci nevasta mea să învârtească la râşniţă pentru altul şi alţii să aibă parte de ea.
translations.grk: ἀρέσαι ἄρα καὶ ἡ γυνή μου ἑτέρῳ, τὰ δὲ νήπιά μου ταπεινωθείη.

verses.geez: ወለእመ፡ አመዕኩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ገብርየ፡ ወአመትየ፡ ሶበ፡ ይትዋቀሡ፡ በኀቤየ።
verses.translation: For the rage of anger is not to be controlled, in the case of defiling another man's wife.

translations.lxx: For the rage of anger is not to be controlled, in the case of defiling another man's wife.
translations.kjv: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
translations.ron: Căci aceasta ar fi o urâciune, o nelegiuire vrednică de pedeapsa judecătorilor,
translations.grk: Θυμὸς γὰρ ὀργῆς ἀκατάσχετος, τὸ μιᾶναι ἀνδρὸς γυναῖκα.

verses.geez: ወምንተ፡ እሬሲ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እመ፡ ገብረ፡ ሐተታየ፡ ወእመኒቦ፡ ዘሐወጸኒ፡ እትዋሣእኑ፡ ቅድሜሁ።
verses.translation: For it is a fire burning on every side, and whomsoever it attacks, it utterly destroys.

translations.lxx: For it is a fire burning on every side, and whomsoever it attacks, it utterly destroys.
translations.kjv: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
translations.ron: Un foc care mistuie până la iad şi care nimiceşte toată strânsura mea;
translations.grk: Πῦρ γάρ ἐστι καιόμενον ἐπὶ πάντων τῶν μερῶν, οὗδʼ ἂν ἐπέλθῃ ἐκ ῥιζῶν ἀπώλεσεν.

verses.geez: አኮኑ፡ በከመ፡ ተፈጠርኩ፡ አነ፡ በውስተ፡ ከርሠ፡ እምየ፡ እሙንቱሂ፡ ከማሁ፡ ኮኑ፡ ወነበርነ፡ ውስተ፡ ይእቲ፡ ከርሥ።
verses.translation: And if too I despised the judgment of my servant or my handmaid, when they pleaded with me;

translations.lxx: And if too I despised the judgment of my servant or my handmaid, when they pleaded with me;
translations.kjv: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
translations.ron: Dacă aş fi nesocotit dreptul slugii sau al slujnicei mele, în socotelile lor cu mine,
translations.grk: Εἰ δὲ καὶ ἐφαύλισα κρίμα θεράποντός μου ἢ θεραπαίνης, κρινομένων αὐτῶν πρὸς μὲ,

verses.geez: ወትካትሰ፡ ግብረ፡ አደምዕ፡ ዘፈቀድኩ፡ ወኢመሰውኩ፡ ዓይነ፡ ፅቤር።
verses.translation: what then shall I do if the Lord should try me? and if also he should at all visit me, can I make an answer?

translations.lxx: what then shall I do if the Lord should try me? and if also he should at all visit me, can I make an answer?
translations.kjv: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
translations.ron: Ce mă voi face eu; când Dumnezeu se va ridica şi ce răspuns ti voi da, când va lua procesul în cercetare?
translations.grk: τί γὰρ ποιήσω ἐὰν ἔτασίν μου ποιῆται ὁ Κύριος; ἐὰν δὲ καὶ ἐπισκοπήν τινα, ἀπόκρισιν ποιήσομαι;

verses.geez: ሶበሁ፡ ባሕቲትየ፡ በላዕኩ፡ እክልየ፡ ወኢወሀብኩ፡ ለእጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ እምኔሁ።
verses.translation: Were not they too formed as I also was formed in the womb? yea, we were formed in the same womb.

translations.lxx: Were not they too formed as I also was formed in the womb? yea, we were formed in the same womb.
translations.kjv: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
translations.ron: Cel ce m-a făcut pe mine în pântecele mamei mele nu l-a făcut şi pe robul meu? Nu este, oare, El singur Care ne-a alcătuit în pântece?
translations.grk: Πότερον οὐχ ὡς καὶ ἐγὼ ἐγενόμην ἐν γαστρὶ, καὶ ἐκεῖνοι γεγόνασι; γεγόναμεν δὲ ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ κοιλίᾳ.

verses.geez: ወአሐፅኖ፡ እምንእሱ፡ ከመ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወአልኅቆ፡ እምከርሠ፡ እሙ፡ እምአመ፡ ተወልደ።
verses.translation: But the helpless missed not whatever need they had, and I did not cause the eye of the widow to fail.

translations.lxx: But the helpless missed not whatever need they had, and I did not cause the eye of the widow to fail.
translations.kjv: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
translations.ron: Datu-m-am, oare, în lături, când săracul dorea ceva şi lăsat-am să se stingă de plânsete ochii văduvelor?
translations.grk: Ἀδύνατοι δὲ χρείαν ἥν ποτε εἶχον οὐκ ἀπέτυχον, χήρας δὲ τὸν ὀφθαλμὸν οὐκ ἐξέτηξα·

verses.geez: ወእመሂ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ዕሩቀ፡ ወኢያልበስኩ፡ እንዘ፡ ይመውት፡ በቊር።
verses.translation: And if too I ate my morsel alone, and did not impart of it to the orphan;

translations.lxx: And if too I ate my morsel alone, and did not impart of it to the orphan;
translations.kjv: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
translations.ron: Mâncam, oare, singur bucata mea de pâine şi orfanului nu-i dădeam din ea?
translations.grk: Εἰ δὲ καὶ τὸν ψωμόν μου ἔφαγον μόνος, καὶ οὐχὶ ὀρφανῷ μετέδωκα·

verses.geez: ወይድኅሩኒ፡ ስኡናን፡ ወእምጸምረ፡ አባዕግየ፡ ሞቀ፡ ዘባና፡ ቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: (for I nourished them as a father from my youth, and guided them from my mother's womb.)

translations.lxx: (for I nourished them as a father from my youth, and guided them from my mother's womb.)
translations.kjv: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)
translations.ron: Dimpotrivă, din tinereţile mele, am crescut pe orfan ca un tată şi de la naştere, am călăuzit pe văduvă.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐκ νεότητός μου ἐξέτρεφον ὡς πατὴρ, καὶ ἐκ γαστρὸς μητρός μου ὡδήγησα·

verses.geez: አመ፡ አንሣእኩ፡ እዴየ፡ ዲበ፡ እጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ ተአሚንየ፡ ከመ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ረድኤት፡ ብየ፡ ይትመተር፡ መዝራዕትየ፡ እመታ፡ ክፍትየ፡ ወይትቀጥቀጥ፡ እዴየ፡ እምኵርባዕየ።
verses.translation: And if too I overlooked the naked as he was perishing, and did not clothe him;

translations.lxx: And if too I overlooked the naked as he was perishing, and did not clothe him;
translations.kjv: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
translations.ron: Dacă vedeam un nenorocit fără haină şi vreun sărac care n-avea cămaşă pe el,
translations.grk: Εἰ δὲ καὶ ὑπερεῖδον γυμνὸν ἀπολλύμενον, καὶ οὐκ ἠμφίασα αὐτόν·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ግርማ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አኃዘኒ፡ ወኢያመስጥ፡ እምኢኂዞቱ።
verses.translation: and if the poor did not bless me, and their shoulders were not warmed with the fleece of my lambs;

translations.lxx: and if the poor did not bless me, and their shoulders were not warmed with the fleece of my lambs;
translations.kjv: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
translations.ron: Nu mă binecuvântau coapsele lui şi nu-l încălzea lâna mieilor mei?
translations.grk: Ἀδύνατοι δὲ εἰ μὴ εὐλόγησάν με, ἀπὸ δὲ κουρᾶς ἀμνῶν μοῦ ἐθερμάνθησαν οἱ ὦμοι αὐτῶν·

verses.geez: ወእመሂ፡ ደፈንኩ፡ ወርቅየ፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት፡ ወአመ፡ ተአመንኩ፡ በዕንቊ፡ ዘብዙኅ፡ ሤጡ።
verses.translation: if I lifted my hand against an orphan, trusting that my strength was far superior to his:

translations.lxx: if I lifted my hand against an orphan, trusting that my strength was far superior to his:
translations.kjv: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
translations.ron: Dacă am repezit mâna mea împotriva vreunui orfan, fiindcă vedeam că am sprijinitori la masa judecăţii,
translations.grk: Εἰ ἐπῆρα ὀρφανῷ χεῖρα, πεποιθὼς ὅτι πολλή μοι βοήθεια περίεστιν·

verses.geez: ወእመ፡ ተፈሣሕኩ፡ በብዙኅ፡ ብዕልየ፡ ወእመ፡ ወደይኩ፡ እዴየ፡ ዲበ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ኍልቁ።
verses.translation: let then my shoulder start from the blade-bone, and my arm be crushed off from the elbow.

translations.lxx: let then my shoulder start from the blade-bone, and my arm be crushed off from the elbow.
translations.kjv: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
translations.ron: Atunci să cadă umărul meu din încheietură şi braţul meu să se dezlege de osul celălalt!
translations.grk: Ἀποσταίη ἄρα ὁ ὦμός μου ἀπὸ τῆς κλειδός, ὁ δὲ βραχίων μου ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀγκῶνος συντριβείη.

verses.geez: ወኢይሬእይኑ፡ ፀሐየ፡ ዘያበርህ፡ ወይጠፍእ፡ ወወርኅኒ፡ ትበኪ፡ እስመ፡ ኢትኴንን፡ ርእሳ።
verses.translation: For the fear of the Lord constrained me, and I cannot bear up by reason of his burden.

translations.lxx: For the fear of the Lord constrained me, and I cannot bear up by reason of his burden.
translations.kjv: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
translations.ron: Dar eu mă temeam de pedeapsa lui Dumnezeu şi înaintea măreţiei Lui nu puteam să stau.
translations.grk: Φόβος γὰρ Κυρίου συνέσχε με, ἀπὸ τοῦ λήμματος αὐτοῦ οὐχ ὑποίσω.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘአስሐቶ፡ ለልብየ፡ በጽሚት፡ ወእመ፡ ወደይኩ፡ እዴየ፡ ዲበ፡ አፉየ፡ ወእመ፡ ሰሚዐ፡ ሰማዕኩ፡ ወተጸመምኩ።
verses.translation: If I made gold my treasure, and if too I trusted the precious stone;

translations.lxx: If I made gold my treasure, and if too I trusted the precious stone;
translations.kjv: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;
translations.ron: Mi-am pus eu încrederea în aur sau am zis aurului lămurit: Tu eşti nădejdea mea?
translations.grk: Εἰ ἔταξα χρυσίον εἰς χοῦν μου, εἰ δὲ καὶ λίθῳ πολυτελεῖ ἐπεποίθησα,

verses.geez: ወዝኒ፡ ይኩነኒ፡ ዓቢየ፡ ኃጢአተ፡ እመ፡ ሐሰውኩ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ልዑል።
verses.translation: and if too I rejoiced when my wealth was abundant, and if too I laid my hand on innumerable treasures:

translations.lxx: and if too I rejoiced when my wealth was abundant, and if too I laid my hand on innumerable treasures:
translations.kjv: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
translations.ron: Ori eram fericit peste măsură, că aveam atâta avere şi că mâna mea agonisise mult?
translations.grk: εἰ δὲ καὶ εὐφράνθην πολλοῦ πλούτου μου γενομένου, εἰ δὲ καὶ ἐπʼ ἀναριθμήτοις ἐθέμην χεῖρά μου·

verses.geez: ወእመ፡ ተፈሣሕኩ፡ በድቀተ፡ ጸላእትየ፡ ወእመ፡ እቤ፡ በልብየ፡ እንቋዕ።
verses.translation: (do we not see the shining sun eclipsed, and the moon waning? for they have not power to continue:)

translations.lxx: (do we not see the shining sun eclipsed, and the moon waning? for they have not power to continue:)
translations.kjv: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
translations.ron: Ori când vedeam soarele în strălucirea lui şi luna înaintând cu măreţie,
translations.grk: Ἢ οὐχ ὁρῶμεν ἥλιον τὸν ἐπιθαύσκοντα ἐκλείποντα, σελήνην δὲ φθίνουσαν; οὐ γὰρ ἐπʼ αὐτοῖς ἐστί·

verses.geez: ለትስማዕ፡ ዕዝንየ፡ እኩየ፡ ወይጻእሊተ፡ ስም፡ እኩይ፡ በውስተ፡ ሕዝብየ።
verses.translation: and if my heart was secretly deceived, and if I have laid my hand upon my mouth and kissed it:

translations.lxx: and if my heart was secretly deceived, and if I have laid my hand upon my mouth and kissed it:
translations.kjv: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
translations.ron: A fost inima mea amăgită în taină şi am dus eu mâna la gură, ca s-o sărut?
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰ ἠπατήθη λάθρα ἡ καρδία μου, εἰ δὲ χεῖρά μου ἐπιθεὶς ἐπὶ στόματί μου ἐφίλησα.

verses.geez: ወይቤሉ፡ ነባርየ፡ መኑ፡ እምወህበነ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ንብላዕ፡ እንዘ፡ ጥቀ፡ እምሕሮሙ።
verses.translation: let this also then be reckoned to me as the greatest iniquity: for I should have lied against the Lord Most High.

translations.lxx: let this also then be reckoned to me as the greatest iniquity: for I should have lied against the Lord Most High.
translations.kjv: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.
translations.ron: Şi aceasta ar fi fost o mare fărădelege, fiindcă aş fi tăgăduit pe Dumnezeul cel Preaînalt.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῦτό μοι ἄρα ἀνομία ἡ μεγίστη λογισθείη, ὅτι ἐψευσάμην ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ ὑψίστου.

verses.geez: ወበአፍእ፡ ኢኃደረ፡ ነግድ፡ ወለኵሉ፡ ዘነጽአ፡ ርኅው፡ ቤትየ፡ ወእመ፡ አበስኩ፡ ወከባትኩ፡ ይኩነኒ፡ ዓቢየ፡ ጌጋየ።
verses.translation: And if too I was glad at the fall of mine enemies, and mine heart said, Aha!

translations.lxx: And if too I was glad at the fall of mine enemies, and mine heart said, Aha!
translations.kjv: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
translations.ron: M-am bucurat eu de nenorocirea duşmanului meu şi am tresăltat când vreo răutate dăduse peste el?
translations.grk: Εἰ δὲ καὶ ἐπιχαρὴς ἐγενόμην πτώματι ἐχθρῶν μου, καὶ εἶπεν ἡ καρδία μου, εὖγε.

verses.geez: ወኃፈርኩ፡ እምብዙኅ፡ ሰብእ፡ ተናሕዮ፡ በኀቤሆሙ፡ ወለእመ፡ ምስኪን፡ ይወፅእ፡ እምኆኅትየ፡ እንዘ፡ ዕራቁ።
verses.translation: let then mine ear hear my curse, and let me be a by-word among my people in my affliction.

translations.lxx: let then mine ear hear my curse, and let me be a by-word among my people in my affliction.
translations.kjv: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
translations.ron: Eu n-am îngăduit limbii mele să greşească şi să ceară moartea duşmanului, blestemându-l.
translations.grk: Ἀκούσαι ἄρα τὸ οὖς μου τὴν κατάραν μου, θρυληθείην δὲ ἄρα ὑπὸ λαοῦ μου κακούμενος.

verses.geez: መኑ፡ እምወሀበኒ፡ ዘያጸምእኒ፡ ወእመ፡ ኢፈራህኩ፡ እደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወእመ፡ ብየ፡ መጽሐሰ፡ ዕዳ፡ ዘይፈድየኒ፡ እፀውር፡ ዲበ፡ መታክፍትየ፡ ወእነብባ፡ በኀበ፡ ብዙኀን።
verses.translation: And if too my handmaids have often said, Oh that we might be satisfied with his flesh; (whereas I was very kind:

translations.lxx: And if too my handmaids have often said, Oh that we might be satisfied with his flesh; (whereas I was very kind:
translations.kjv: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
translations.ron: Oamenii care ţineau de casa mea ziceau: "Unde s-ar găsi vreunul care să nu se fi săturat la masa lui?"
translations.grk: Εἰ δὲ καὶ πολλάκις εἶπον αἱ θεράπαιναί μου, τίς ἄν δῴη ἡμῖν τῶν σαρκῶν αὐτοῦ πλησθῆναι; λίαν μου χρηστοῦ ὄντος·

verses.geez: ወእሰጥጣ፡ ወእገብእ፡ እንዘ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘእነሥእ፡ እምኀበ፡ ዘይፈድየኒ።
verses.translation: for the stranger did not lodge without, and my door was opened to every one that came:)

translations.lxx: for the stranger did not lodge without, and my door was opened to every one that came:)
translations.kjv: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
translations.ron: Străinul nu petrecea noaptea niciodată afară; porţile mele le deschideam călătorului.
translations.grk: Ἔξω δὲ οὐκ ηὐλίζετο ξένος, ἡ δὲ θύρα μου παντὶ ἐλθόντι ἀνέῳκτο·

verses.geez: ወለእመ፡ አግዓርክዋ፡ ለምድር፡ ወእመ፡ በከየ፡ ትለሚሃ።
verses.translation: or if too having sinned unintentionally, I hid my sin;

translations.lxx: or if too having sinned unintentionally, I hid my sin;
translations.kjv: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
translations.ron: Acoperit-am eu, ca lumea cealaltă, păcatele mele, ascunzând, în sânul meu, greşeala făptuită,
translations.grk: Εἰ δὲ καὶ ἁμαρτὼν ἀκουσίως ἔκρυψα τὴν ἁμαρτίαν μου·

verses.geez: ወእመ፡ በላዕኩ፡ እክልየ፡ ናሕቲትየ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ሤጥ፡ ወእመ፡ ሰደድክዎ፡ ለበዓለ፡ ምድር፡ ወአሕመምኩ፡ ነፍሶ።
verses.translation: (for I did not stand in awe of a great multitude, so as not to declare boldly before them:) and if too I permitted a poor man to go out of my door with an empty bosom:

translations.lxx: (for I did not stand in awe of a great multitude, so as not to declare boldly before them:) and if too I permitted a poor man to go out of my door with an empty bosom:
translations.kjv: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
translations.ron: Pentru că, adică, mă temeam de zarva cetăţii şi mă înspăimânta dispreţul cetăţenilor şi atunci rămâneam fără glas şi nu mai mă arătam în poartă?
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ διετράπην πολυοχλίαν πλήθους, τοῦ μὴ ἐξαγορεῦσαι ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν· εἰ δὲ καὶ εἴασα ἀδύνατον ἐξελθεῖν θύραν μου κόλπῳ κενῷ·

verses.geez: ህየንተ፡ ሥርናይ፡ ክርዳድ፡ ይብቊለኒ፡ ወህየንተ፡ ሰገምሕንጽዋል፡ ይብቊለኒ፡ ወኃደገ፡ ኢዮብ፡ ነገረ።
verses.translation: (Oh that I had a hearer,) and if I had not feared the hand of the Lord; and as to the written charge which I had against any one,

translations.lxx: (Oh that I had a hearer,) and if I had not feared the hand of the Lord; and as to the written charge which I had against any one,
translations.kjv: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.
translations.ron: O, cine, îmi va da pe cineva care să mă asculte? Iată aici iscălitura mea! Cel Atotputernic să-mi răspundă! Iar învinuirea scrisă de potrivnicii mei,
translations.grk: Τίς δῴη ἀκούοντά μου; χεῖρα δὲ Κυρίου εἰ μὴ ἐδεδοίκειν· συγγραφὴν δὲ ἣν εἶχον κατά τινος,
